notes.title: Surprise! Fresh Pardon My French Toast news tonight
notes.content:
Rejoice, toasts: We baked some fresh Pardon My French Toast news that you can discover this evening during the AG French Direct.

Amidst the many announcements from other French developers, we've prepared a few surprises for you!

We're counting on you to join us tonight at 6pm on ActuGaming's Youtube channel!

[previewyoutube=_mJfGPdssCU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Watch us on Twitch during the Games Made in France event!
notes.content:
[h1]Pardon My French Toast on Twitch!![/h1]
We are invited to [b]share more news[/b] about our brand new 3D platformer game Pardon My French Toast this week.

Join us this Friday, May 16 at 6pm for a livestreaming experience of the demo! We'll be there to comment and answer your questions!!

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/mistermv]MisterMV's Twitch channel[/url]
